notes.title: Demo Release!
notes.content:
[h1]Hold on to your feathers![/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45344857/5ba93bc22857ec763d060c838f0f4f4b43b38c14.png[/img]

Check out the Demo [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3520360/Quail_Crossing_Demo/]here![/url]

Frantically dash and dodge across hectic streets and experience the daring life of a quail in the first 5 levels of Quail Crossing! Hatch eggs and gather a bevy of Baby Quail while you avoid traffic to reach the goal, but be quick, you have limited time to save them in each level!

I'm proud to say after almost an entire year of development in my spare time as a solo developer that Quail Crossing finally has a playable demo! It has been a difficult journey just to get such a silly game to an actual Steam release. But I hope you enjoy it!

Stay tuned for updates about the release, as well as more features to come in the full version!
